summary: Independent final review approves FLOW-001 at b8be8018c2746ab36ce5f51e4c865d4d773e8761 with no blocking findings. The shared camila-demo-v2 reducer and derived selectors implement the exact prepared reply, stable clinical and transportation ownership, separate nurse acceptance and human disposition, complete versioned transport planning, acknowledgment invalidation after plan failure, deterministic checkpoint/reset behavior, and confirmation only after all three required closure conditions. Staff, patient, caregiver, graph, and audit views consume the same scenario state; the caregiver projection preserves its transportation-only boundary, scenario and delivery time meanings remain explicit, and attendance remains unknown. The implementation extends the locked Clinical Glass components without a new visual system or dependency. Independent TARGETED testing is complete, and repository verification passed at source-and-test commit 1a8e3f5bdc239e83b1d129379c58693ccd5e8f32, including frontend build, smoke, and full end-to-end checks; the later commits contain only the verification report and lifecycle status, so that commit-bound evidence remains applicable under the repository evidence-freshness rules. LOW risk correctly requires no dedicated security review. FLOW-001 is ready for the shared sprint branch to continue to the next slice and eventual human-authorized merge.
